description: Create a PURPLE-styled array [3, 1, 4, 1, 5] with indexes, then swap elements at positions 1 and 3 to show an in-place sort step.
code:
from manim import *
from manim_dsa import MArray, MArrayStyle

class MArraySwapElements(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        arr = (
            MArray([3, 1, 4, 1, 5], style=MArrayStyle.PURPLE)
            .add_indexes()
            .add_label(Text("data", font_size=24))
        )
        self.play(Create(arr))
        self.wait(0.3)
        self.play(arr.animate.swap(1, 3))
        self.wait(0.3)
